title: ATC Cycle Time — Degraded
description: ATC arm cycle time P022 = {val} s, exceeds nominal {val2} s by >20%. Clamp pressure P021 = {val3} bar.
probable_cause: ATC cylinder seal wear, lubrication degradation, or magazine drive motor wear.
diagnostic_steps: Run 5 consecutive ATC cycles and log P022
remedy: Grease ATC arm pivot. If cycle time continues degrading, replace ATC cylinder seals.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
escalation_path: If TCS-SR-001 is not addressed (complete current cycle then stop. schedule maintenance within 4 hours.), the fault will escalate in this order: TCS-MJ-001, then TCS-MD-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
